PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-008.text: Authenticated users must not read other users' discord_uid or PII from member table.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-008.assertion: forall u: SELECT member.members WHERE id != u.id => exclude(discord_uid, email)

locations.note: createClient uses NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY with RLS enforcement; access to other users' discord_uid depends on RLS policies in Supabase DB (not in source)
Own member data fetched with .eq('supabase_auth_user_id', user.id) filter — only self-access at app layer
